note: ModListWidget.method_25311 draws its custom list background through 1.20.1 RenderSystem/Shader calls that were removed in 1.21.1 (tombstones t1-t4). They cannot be forwarded sensibly, so the body is replaced with a DrawContext-based renderer that paints a plain row background and then calls the unchanged Entry.method_25343 hook for every entry.
